newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian Koramic says optimistic on 1997.
newsitem.headline: Belgian Koramic says optimistic on 1997.

text.p: Belgian Koramic Building Products NV said on Friday it planned to consolidate in 1997 after expanding its business in 1996 but expected results to improve nonetheless.
"We expect, without any unforeseen and exceptional events, the positive trend which showed itself in the second half of 1996 to continue," Koramic said in a statement on 1996 earnings.

Koramic said net current earnings in the second half of 1997 rose to 757 million francs from 526 million francs in the first half. Net current cash flow in the second half rose to 2.15 billion francs from 1.79 billion in the first six months.
Overall, Koramic said 1996 net current earnings rose 52 percent to 1.28 billion francs. Group net earnings rose 56 percent to 1.22 billion francs.
Sales rose fourfold to 30.48 from 7.36 billion francs, thanks mainly to the group's alliance with Austrian building materials group Wienerberger.
